citations.quote: In discounted cash flow valuation, we try to estimate the intrinsic value of an asset based on its fundamentals.
This reading introduces equity valuation models used to estimate the intrinsic value (synonym: fundamental value) of a security
A company’s intrinsic value can only be estimated because it is impossible to predict the amount and timing of its future cash flows.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Framing intrinsic value as the value an asset would command from a fully informed investor analyzing its expected cash flows and risk — the benchmark against which market price is judged rich, in line, or cheap. Damodaran's DCF foundation and the CFA L1 over/under/fairly-valued classification both estimate intrinsic value and compare to observed price.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Intrinsic Value
